info.description: Backend requests for the standalone command-q IdentityServer and API. For the initial local flow, register, copy the one-time link token and six-digit code from smtp4dev, confirm the email, sign in, create and exchange the authorization code, and provision the application profile. Postman retains the IdentityServer cookie and stores sensitive values only in the active local environment.
